verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS meeting assistant publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a proprietary hosted service with an API, SDKs, webhooks and an MCP server, and never mentions open-source code or a license. The installable SDKs are client libraries, not the product's source under an open license, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
